description: An image (mj-image). is required; matters for a11y.

members.name: Align
members.description: Gets or sets the horizontal alignment (align).

members.name: Alt
members.description: Gets or sets the alternative text (alt). Required for accessibility.

members.name: Border
members.description: Gets or sets the border shorthand (border).

members.name: BorderRadius
members.description: Gets or sets the border radius (border-radius).

members.name: FluidOnMobile
members.description: Gets or sets whether the image becomes fluid on mobile (fluid-on-mobile).

members.name: Height
members.description: Gets or sets the explicit height (height).

members.name: Href
members.description: Gets or sets the link target (href).

members.name: Rel
members.description: Gets or sets the link rel attribute.

members.name: Src
members.description: Gets or sets the image source URL (src).

members.name: Target
members.description: Gets or sets the link target window (target).

members.name: Title
members.description: Gets or sets the image title (title).

members.name: Width
members.description: Gets or sets the explicit width (width).
